Unsupported short/lot policies are explicit outcomes, not accidental resets. For the source-backed declared spot capability, a versioned policy may select SpotWac; each other provider/instrument leaf must declare its own policy schema. FIFO/lot, short, split, and token-migration variants require a versioned policy entry, otherwise the result is UnsupportedAccountingPolicy/Unavailable and never a WAC reset.
